title: Prefab
description: A prefab file (§6.3): never contains Prefab or PrefabLink components.

Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

Root.description: The id of the prefab's single root entity.

ComponentVersions.description: The version of every component type present, by registry name.

ID.description: The entity's persistent identity, written as the entity key "ID".
The entity's UUID; set at creation and never changed.

Name.description: The entity's display name, written as the entity key "Name".
The display name used by entity paths; names need not be unique.

Tags.description: The entity's gameplay tags, written as the entity key "Tags".
Free-form tags such as "Player"; non-empty, unique, in insertion order.

Relationship.description: The entity's place in the hierarchy; its parent is written as the entity key "Parent".

Parent.description: The parent entity; null for a root entity.

Transform.description: Positions, rotates and scales the entity relative to its parent.

Translation.description: Position relative to the parent, in metres.

Rotation.description: Rotation relative to the parent: a unit quaternion written [x, y, z, w].

Scale.description: Scale along the local axes; each component's magnitude is at least 0.0001.

Prefab.description: Marks the root of a prefab instance; an outermost one records the overrides of its instance and of the instances nested in it.
The prefab asset the instance was created from.

Overrides.description: The differences of an outermost instance from its prefab, sorted by path, component, kind and field; empty on a nested instance root.

PrefabLink.description: Links an entity of a prefab instance, its root included, to its entity in the prefab of its innermost instance.

PrefabEntityID.description: The entity's ID in the prefab of its innermost instance.

InstanceRoot.description: The root of the entity's innermost instance (an instance root names itself), which has the Prefab component.

OuterPrefabEntityID.description: On a nested instance root: its id in the prefab of the instance that encloses it; null on every other entity.

MeshRenderer.description: Draws a mesh asset with one material per submesh.

Mesh.description: The mesh to draw; null draws nothing.

Materials.description: One material per submesh; an empty list or a null slot uses the mesh's default material for that submesh.

ReceiveShadows.description: Whether shadows fall on the mesh.

Visible.description: Whether the mesh is drawn at all.

Camera.description: Renders the scene from the entity, looking down its local -Z axis.

VerticalFov.description: The vertical field of view of the perspective projection, in degrees.

OrthographicSize.description: Half the visible height of the orthographic projection, in metres.

NearClip.description: The near clipping distance, in metres; below FarClip.

FarClip.description: The far clipping distance, in metres; beyond it nothing is drawn or culled in.

Primary.description: Whether this is the scene's primary camera (exactly one active camera should be).

Clear.description: What the camera draws behind the scene.

ClearColor.description: The linear background colour when Clear is Color.

DirectionalLight.description: A sun-like light shining down the entity's local -Z axis.

Intensity.description: The unitless brightness multiplied with Color.

CastShadows.description: Whether the light casts cascaded soft shadows.

ShadowDistance.description: How far from the camera shadows reach, in metres.

CascadeCount.description: The number of shadow cascades, from 1 to 4.

CascadeSplitLambda.description: The cascade split blend from uniform (0) to logarithmic (1).

LightAngle.description: The angular diameter of the light source, in degrees; larger values soften shadow penumbrae.

DepthBias.description: The shadow depth bias, in shadow-map texels.

NormalBias.description: The shadow normal-offset bias, in shadow-map texels.

PointLight.description: A light shining in every direction from the entity.

Intensity.description: The unitless brightness multiplied with Color.

Range.description: The distance at which the light's falloff reaches zero, in metres.

CastShadows.description: Whether the light casts soft shadows (at most four point lights per view; the shadow budget applies).

SourceRadius.description: The radius of the emitting sphere, in metres; widens highlights and shadow penumbrae.

SpotLight.description: A cone of light shining down the entity's local -Z axis.

Intensity.description: The unitless brightness multiplied with Color.

Range.description: The distance at which the light's falloff reaches zero, in metres.

InnerConeAngle.description: The angle from the axis inside which the light is at full strength, in degrees; below OuterConeAngle.

OuterConeAngle.description: The angle from the axis at which the light fades to zero, in degrees.

CastShadows.description: Whether the light casts soft shadows (shadow atlas budget applies).

SourceRadius.description: The radius of the emitting disc, in metres; widens highlights and shadow penumbrae.

Environment.description: The scene's image-based lighting and skybox (one per scene).
The environment map; null lights the scene with FallbackColor.

Intensity.description: The unitless strength of the image-based lighting.

Rotation.description: The rotation of the environment about the +Y axis, in degrees.

ShowSkybox.description: Whether cameras that clear to the skybox show the environment map.

SkyboxBlur.description: How blurred the visible skybox is, from sharp (0) to fully blurred (1).

FallbackColor.description: The linear ambient colour used when no environment map is assigned.

PostProcess.description: The scene's exposure (manual or automatic), tone mapping and grading, ambient occlusion, reflections, bloom and anti-aliasing (one per scene).

ExposureEV.description: The exposure compensation in stops: the image is multiplied by 2^EV.

ExposureMode.description: Manual exposure, or automatic exposure from the image's luminance histogram.

AutoExposureMinEV.description: The darkest and brightest exposure automatic exposure may adapt to, in stops.

AutoExposureMaxEV.description: The darkest and brightest exposure automatic exposure may adapt to, in stops.

AutoExposureSpeedUp.description: How many stops per second automatic exposure adapts towards a brighter or a darker exposure.

AutoExposureSpeedDown.description: How many stops per second automatic exposure adapts towards a brighter or a darker exposure.

Lut.description: The colour-grading LUT applied after the tone mapping curve; null grades nothing.

LutIntensity.description: How much of the graded colour replaces the ungraded one, from 0 to 1.

SsaoEnabled.description: Whether screen-space ambient occlusion (GTAO) is applied. It darkens the environment's image-based light only (the Environment's FallbackColor ambient without a map), never direct lights.

SsaoRadius.description: The world-space radius within which ambient occlusion is sampled, in metres. An occluder further than this in front of a surface casts little occlusion on it: set it above the depth gap between the pieces and the surface behind them.

SsaoIntensity.description: The strength of the ambient occlusion, which darkens the environment's image-based light only, never direct lights.

SsrEnabled.description: Whether glossy surfaces reflect what is on screen (screen-space reflections), falling back to the probes where a ray misses.

SsrIntensity.description: How strongly screen-space reflections replace the probes' reflection, from 0 to 1.

SsrMaxDistance.description: How far a reflected ray travels, in metres.

SsrThickness.description: How thick a surface is assumed behind its depth when a ray passes it, in metres.

SsrMaxRoughness.description: The perceptual roughness above which only the probes reflect.

BloomIntensity.description: How much of the bloom is blended into the image.

AntiAliasing.description: How edges are anti-aliased: none, FXAA (the default) or TAA.

Text.description: Draws a text string on the screen or in the world.
The UTF-8 text; a line feed starts a new line.

Font.description: The font; null uses the default font.

Size.description: The em size. Screen space: pixels at the 1080p reference resolution, scaled by the viewport's height / 1080. World space: an em of Size / 100 metres (100 world-text pixels per metre) before the entity's scale, in the entity's local XY plane or facing the camera with Billboard, so the default 32 is 0.32 m.

Color.description: The linear text colour with opacity in the fourth component.

Space.description: Whether the text is placed on the screen or in the world.

Anchor.description: Screen space: the point of the viewport the text is placed at, normalized: (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1, 1) the bottom-right, X to the right and Y down; (0.5, 0.5) is the centre.

Pivot.description: The point of the text block that sits on the anchor (Screen space) or at the entity's origin (World space), normalized to the block: (0, 0) is its top-left corner and (1, 1) its bottom-right.

Offset.description: Screen space: a further offset from the anchor in pixels at the 1080p reference resolution (scaled with the viewport's height), X to the right and Y down.

Alignment.description: How the lines are aligned to each other.

Billboard.description: Whether world-space text always faces the camera.

RigidBody.description: Simulates the entity with Jolt physics.

Type.description: Static never moves; Kinematic is moved by script; Dynamic is simulated.

Friction.description: The friction coefficient of the body's surfaces. A contact uses the geometric mean of both bodies' values, so 0 on one body removes friction from all its contacts.

Restitution.description: Bounciness, from no bounce (0) to a perfectly elastic bounce (1). A contact uses the larger of both bodies' values, so 1 on a ball makes it bounce elastically off every surface.

LinearDamping.description: How quickly linear velocity decays, per second.

AngularDamping.description: How quickly angular velocity decays, per second.

GravityFactor.description: The multiplier of the project's gravity for this body (0 floats).

AllowSleeping.description: Whether the body may sleep when it comes to rest.

LockTranslation.description: Per world axis: whether the body cannot move along it.

LockRotation.description: Per world axis: whether the body cannot rotate about it.

Layer.description: Physics layer name from project settings.

MaxLinearVelocity.description: The speed the body is clamped to, in metres per second.

MaxAngularVelocity.description: The angular speed the body is clamped to, in radians per second; raise it for fast rolling balls.

EnhancedInternalEdgeRemoval.description: Removes ghost collisions with internal edges of compound shapes; set it on rolling bodies.

InitialLinearVelocity.description: The world-space velocity the body starts with, in metres per second.

InitialAngularVelocity.description: The world-space angular velocity the body starts with, in radians per second.

BoxCollider.description: A box-shaped collider in the entity's space.

HalfExtents.description: Half the box's size along each local axis, in metres; at least 1 mm.

Offset.description: The box centre relative to the entity, in metres.

Rotation.description: The box rotation relative to the entity: a unit quaternion.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

SphereCollider.description: A sphere-shaped collider in the entity's space.

Radius.description: The sphere radius, in metres; at least 1 mm.

Offset.description: The sphere centre relative to the entity, in metres.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

CapsuleCollider.description: A capsule-shaped collider along the local Y axis.

Radius.description: The radius of the capsule's hemispheres and cylinder, in metres; at least 1 mm.

HalfHeight.description: Half the height of the cylinder between the hemispheres, in metres; at least 1 mm.

Offset.description: The capsule centre relative to the entity, in metres.

Rotation.description: The capsule rotation relative to the entity: a unit quaternion.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

MeshCollider.description: A collider shaped like a mesh: its convex hull, or the exact triangles for Static and Kinematic bodies.

Mesh.description: The collision mesh; null uses the entity's MeshRenderer mesh.

Convex.description: Whether the convex hull is used; a non-convex mesh collider needs a Static or Kinematic body.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

CharacterController.description: Moves the entity as a walking character that climbs steps and slopes and collides with the world.

Height.description: The character's total height, in metres.

Radius.description: The radius of the character's capsule, in metres.

MaxSlopeAngle.description: The steepest slope the character can walk up, in degrees.

StepHeight.description: The highest step the character climbs without jumping, in metres.

Mass.description: The character's mass in kilograms, used when it pushes bodies.

GravityFactor.description: The multiplier of the project's gravity for the character.

Layer.description: Physics layer name from project settings.

InheritGroundVelocity.description: While grounded, the character also moves with the horizontal velocity of what it stands on, so a moving platform carries it.

AudioSource.description: Plays an audio clip, optionally positioned at the entity.

Clip.description: The audio clip to play; null plays nothing.

Volume.description: The linear volume multiplier (1 is the clip's own level).

Pitch.description: The playback speed and pitch multiplier (1 is unchanged).

Loop.description: Whether the clip restarts when it ends.

PlayOnStart.description: Whether the clip starts playing when the play session starts.

Spatial.description: Whether the sound is positioned at the entity and attenuated with distance.

MinDistance.description: The distance within which the sound plays at full volume, in metres.

MaxDistance.description: The distance beyond which the sound stops getting quieter, in metres.

Attenuation.description: The distance attenuation model of a spatial sound.

Rolloff.description: How quickly the attenuation model falls off (1 is the model's own rate).

DopplerFactor.description: The strength of the Doppler pitch shift (0 disables it).

Group.description: The mixer group the sound plays in.

AudioListener.description: Hears the scene from the entity's position and orientation.

Primary.description: Whether this listener is used; with several primaries the first in canonical order wins, without any the primary camera listens.

Script.description: Attaches Behaviour scripts to the entity, an ordered list of slots.

Scripts.description: The behaviours of the entity, in slot order; each slot is its own instance.

SpriteRenderer.description: Draws a sprite: a sprite sheet frame or a texture in the entity's XY plane.

Sheet.description: The sprite sheet whose frame Frame is drawn; null draws Texture whole.

Frame.description: The index of the sheet's frame to draw; an index the sheet lacks draws nothing (SPRITE_FRAME_OUT_OF_RANGE).

Texture.description: The texture drawn whole, pivoted at its centre, when Sheet is null; null draws the built-in white square.

Color.description: The linear colour every texel is multiplied with, with opacity in the fourth component.

FlipX.description: Whether the image is mirrored left to right about its pivot.

FlipY.description: Whether the image is mirrored top to bottom about its pivot.

PixelsPerUnit.description: How many texels of the image make one unit of the entity's local space; the sprite's size is its texels divided by this.

SortingLayer.description: The sorting layer name from project settings; later layers draw over earlier ones, and an undeclared name draws in the first.

OrderInLayer.description: The draw order within the sorting layer: higher values draw over lower ones, equal values in canonical entity order.

Lit.description: Whether 2D lights light the sprite; an unlit sprite keeps its texels unchanged.

NormalMap.description: A lit sprite's tangent-space normal map, laid like its image; point lights then light it by the angle to the light. Null: flat.

SpriteAnimator.description: Plays a clip of the SpriteRenderer's sprite sheet, one step per clip frame for its ticks, driven by the fixed step.

Clip.description: The name of the sheet's clip to play; empty plays nothing.

Playing.description: Whether the clip advances each fixed step; a clip without Loop clears it after its last step and holds its last frame.

Step.description: The index of the clip step shown.

StepTicks.description: How many fixed steps the current clip step has been shown.

PixelPerfectCamera.description: Renders the entity's camera at a reference resolution, upscaled by the largest whole factor that fits the view in a letterbox.

ReferenceWidth.description: The width the scene renders at, in pixels.

ReferenceHeight.description: The height the scene renders at, in pixels; the orthographic view is this many pixels of PixelsPerUnit high.

PixelsPerUnit.description: How many scene pixels make one world unit; sprites of the same PixelsPerUnit map each texel to one pixel.

LetterboxColor.description: The linear colour of the bars around the upscaled image.

Light2D.description: A 2D light: lights the lit sprites and tilemaps of the view, never unlit ones; no shadows.

Type.description: Whether the light is a point light around the entity or a global light of the whole view.

Intensity.description: How strong the light is: its colour is multiplied by this, so values above 1 overbright.

Radius.description: Point: how far the light reaches from the entity, in world units.

Falloff.description: Point: the fraction of the radius, from its edge inward, over which the light fades smoothly to nothing; 0 is a hard edge.

Height.description: Point: how far above the lit plane the light sits, in world units; only normal-mapped sprites read it.

TilemapRenderer.description: Draws a tilemap's tiles in the entity's XY plane, each tile as a sprite of its palette entry's sheet frame.

Tilemap.description: The tilemap whose tiles are drawn; null draws nothing.

Color.description: The linear colour every tile's texels are multiplied with, with opacity in the fourth component.

PixelsPerUnit.description: How many texels of a tile's frame make one unit of the entity's local space, as a sprite's.

SortingLayer.description: The sorting layer name from project settings; the tilemap sorts with the sprites, and an undeclared name draws in the first.

OrderInLayer.description: The draw order within the sorting layer, among the sprites: higher values draw over lower ones, equal values in canonical entity order.

Lit.description: Whether 2D lights light the tiles; unlit tiles keep their texels unchanged.

RigidBody2D.description: Simulates the entity in the 2D world: moves along world X and Y and rotates about world Z.

Type.description: Static never moves; Kinematic is moved by script; Dynamic is simulated.

Friction.description: The friction coefficient of the body's surfaces; a contact uses the geometric mean of both bodies' values.

Restitution.description: Bounciness, from no bounce (0) to a perfectly elastic bounce (1); a contact uses the larger of both bodies' values.

LinearDamping.description: How quickly linear velocity decays, per second.

AngularDamping.description: How quickly angular velocity decays, per second.

GravityFactor.description: The multiplier of the project's 2D gravity for this body (0 floats).

AllowSleeping.description: Whether the body may sleep when it comes to rest.

FixedRotation.description: Whether a Dynamic body is kept from rotating.

Layer.description: Physics layer name from project settings (the 3D world's layers).

MaxLinearVelocity.description: The speed the body is clamped to, in metres per second.

MaxAngularVelocity.description: The angular speed the body is clamped to, in radians per second.

EnhancedInternalEdgeRemoval.description: Removes ghost collisions with internal edges of compound shapes; set it on bodies that roll or slide across tiles.

InitialLinearVelocity.description: The velocity along world X and Y the body starts with, in metres per second.

InitialAngularVelocity.description: The angular velocity about world Z the body starts with, in radians per second, counter-clockwise seen from +Z.

BoxCollider2D.description: A rectangle collider in the entity's XY plane.

HalfExtents.description: Half the rectangle's size along local X and Y; at least 1 mm.

Offset.description: The rectangle's centre relative to the entity, in its XY plane.

Angle.description: The rectangle's rotation about the entity's Z axis, counter-clockwise, in degrees.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

CircleCollider2D.description: A circle collider in the entity's XY plane.

Radius.description: The circle's radius; at least 1 mm.

Offset.description: The circle's centre relative to the entity, in its XY plane.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

PolygonCollider2D.description: A convex polygon collider in the entity's XY plane.

Points.description: The points whose convex hull is the collider, 3 to 64 of them, in the collider's own space before Offset and Angle.

Offset.description: Where the polygon's origin sits relative to the entity, in its XY plane.

Angle.description: The polygon's rotation about the entity's Z axis, counter-clockwise, in degrees.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

TilemapCollider.description: The solid cells of a tilemap as 2D colliders: each chunk's solid cells merged into boxes, one static compound without a RigidBody2D.

Tilemap.description: The tilemap whose solid cells collide; null takes the entity's TilemapRenderer.Tilemap.

IsTrigger.description: Whether the collider only detects overlaps instead of colliding.

UiCanvas.description: The root of a UI tree, laid out over the whole scene image in scene pixels and drawn after the game's text, or, in World mode, laid out in its own canvas pixels and drawn as a rectangle in the world.

SortOrder.description: Canvases draw in ascending SortOrder, ties in entity order; a later canvas draws over earlier ones.

ScaleMode.description: How canvas units map to scene pixels.

ScaleFactor.description: ConstantPixelSize: the scene pixels per canvas unit.

ReferenceHeight.description: MatchHeight: the canvas's height in canvas units, so one unit is the scene's height / ReferenceHeight scene pixels.

PixelSnap.description: Rounds every element's corners to whole scene pixels, so images and clips land on pixel corners.

Font.description: The font of the canvas's texts whose own Font is null; null uses the default font.

Theme.description: The state tints of the canvas's widgets (buttons, toggles, sliders, scroll views and text inputs).

DefaultFocus.description: The UI widget keyboard and gamepad navigation focuses first while nothing has focus; null: navigation starts only from a pointer press or Ui.SetFocus.

RenderMode.description: Screen draws the canvas over the scene image; World draws it as a rectangle in the world at the entity's transform, depth-tested against the scene.

WorldWidth.description: A World canvas's width in canvas pixels (its layout's scene resolution); Screen canvases ignore it.

WorldHeight.description: A World canvas's height in canvas pixels (its layout's scene resolution); Screen canvases ignore it.

PixelsPerUnit.description: A World canvas's canvas pixels per world unit: its rectangle is WorldWidth x WorldHeight over this, centred on the entity.

UiRect.description: A UI element's rectangle in its parent's (or its canvas's), in canvas units, x right and y down.

AnchorMin.description: The anchor rectangle's top-left corner, normalized in the parent's rectangle: (0, 0) its top-left corner, (1, 1) its bottom-right.

AnchorMax.description: The anchor rectangle's bottom-right corner, normalized in the parent's rectangle; equal to AnchorMin for a fixed-size element.

Pivot.description: The point of the element that Position places, normalized to the element: (0, 0) its top-left corner, (1, 1) its bottom-right.

Position.description: The pivot's offset from its point in the anchor rectangle, in canvas units, x right and y down.

Size.description: The element's size in canvas units, added to the anchor rectangle's size (negative values inset stretched anchors); a container's child takes it as its preferred size.

ClipChildren.description: Whether the element's descendants are clipped to its rectangle.

UiImage.description: Draws a sprite sheet frame, or a plain colour, over a UI element's rectangle.

Sheet.description: The sprite sheet whose frame is drawn; null draws a plain rectangle of Color.

Frame.description: The index of the frame in the sheet's Frames; a frame the sheet lacks draws nothing.

Color.description: The linear tint multiplied with the frame's texels, with opacity in the fourth component.

Type.description: Whether the frame stretches or keeps its 9-slice borders.

BorderScale.description: Sliced: the canvas units each border texel takes.

Filter.description: How the frame's texture is sampled.

RaycastTarget.description: Whether the image catches the pointer for its nearest widget; false lets the pointer pass through it.

UiText.description: Draws text in a UI element's rectangle, wrapped and aligned in it.

Text.description: The UTF-8 text; a line feed starts a new line. Scripts read localized strings with Loc.Get.

Font.description: The font; null uses its canvas's Font, or the default font when the canvas names none.

Size.description: The em size in canvas units.

Color.description: The linear text colour with opacity in the fourth component.

Alignment.description: How each line is aligned within the rectangle's width.

VerticalAlignment.description: Where the text block sits in the rectangle's height.

Wrap.description: Whether lines break at spaces to fit the rectangle's width.

RaycastTarget.description: Whether the text catches the pointer for its nearest widget; false lets the pointer pass through it.

UiLayout.description: A container that places its children's rectangles in a stack, a grid or a flexible row or column.

Direction.description: The main axis the children follow.

Padding.description: Insets of the container's rectangle that the children are placed in.

Spacing.description: The gaps between children, lines and cells along x and y, in canvas units.

MainAlignment.description: Where the children sit along the main axis when they do not fill it.

CrossAlignment.description: Where each child sits across the main axis.

Columns.description: Grid: the cells per row (Horizontal) or per column (Vertical); 0 fits as many as the container holds.

CellSize.description: Grid: the size of each cell in canvas units.

Wrap.description: Flex: whether a child that does not fit the line starts a new line.

UiLayoutElement.description: How a UI element takes part in its parent's layout container: flex weights, a minimum size, or none.

IgnoreLayout.description: Whether the element keeps its own placement and takes no space in the container.

Grow.description: Flex: the element's share of the main axis's free space.

Shrink.description: Flex: the element's share, times its preferred size, of the main axis's overflow.

MinSize.description: The size the element never goes below in a Stack or Flex container, in canvas units.

UiButton.description: A UI button: a pointer click or Submit while focused raises OnUiClick.

Interactable.description: Whether the widget takes the pointer, focus and input; false shows its Disabled tint and raises no event.

Focusable.description: Whether the widget takes keyboard and gamepad focus, from navigation, Ui.SetFocus or a pointer press; false: a press still activates it.

UiToggle.description: A UI toggle: a pointer click or Submit while focused flips IsOn and raises OnUiValueChanged; Graphic shows while it is on.

Interactable.description: Whether the widget takes the pointer, focus and input; false shows its Disabled tint and raises no event.

Focusable.description: Whether the widget takes keyboard and gamepad focus, from navigation, Ui.SetFocus or a pointer press; false: a press still activates it.

Graphic.description: A UI element below the toggle (its check mark) that is drawn and hit only while the toggle is on; null for none.

UiSlider.description: A UI slider: the pointer drags its value between Min and Max and the directions along it step it, raising OnUiValueChanged.

Interactable.description: Whether the widget takes the pointer, focus and input; false shows its Disabled tint and raises no event.

Focusable.description: Whether the widget takes keyboard and gamepad focus, from navigation, Ui.SetFocus or a pointer press; false: a press still activates it.

Value.description: The value, read clamped to Min and Max (and rounded with WholeNumbers).

Min.description: The value at the start edge (left, or bottom when Vertical); below Max.

Max.description: The value at the end edge (right, or top when Vertical).

WholeNumbers.description: Whether the value is rounded to whole numbers.

Step.description: The change per navigation press along the slider; 0 is a tenth of the range. With WholeNumbers it is rounded to a whole number of at least 1.

Direction.description: Horizontal puts Min at the left edge; Vertical puts it at the bottom edge.

Fill.description: A UI element below the slider stretched from the Min edge to the value; null for none.

Handle.description: A UI element below the slider placed at the value; null for none.

UiScrollView.description: A UI scroll view: clips its descendants and moves its Content by the scroll position, which the wheel, a drag and focus change.

Interactable.description: Whether the widget takes the pointer, focus and input; false shows its Disabled tint and raises no event.

Focusable.description: Whether the widget takes keyboard and gamepad focus, from navigation, Ui.SetFocus or a pointer press; false: a press still activates it.

Content.description: The UI element below the scroll view that scrolls; null scrolls nothing.

Horizontal.description: Whether the content scrolls along x.

Vertical.description: Whether the content scrolls along y.

ScrollPosition.description: Canvas units the content is moved left (x) and up (y), read clamped to the content's overflow.

ScrollStep.description: Canvas units per wheel step and per navigation press.

UiTextInput.description: A UI text field: while focused, typed characters insert at its caret and the editing keys edit it, raising OnUiTextChanged; Enter raises OnUiSubmit.

Interactable.description: Whether the widget takes the pointer, focus and input; false shows its Disabled tint and raises no event.

Focusable.description: Whether the widget takes keyboard and gamepad focus, from navigation, Ui.SetFocus or a pointer press; false: a press still activates it.

Text.description: The field's UTF-8 text: typing inserts at the caret; a script's write raises no OnUiTextChanged.

MaxLength.description: The most codepoints typing reaches; characters typed past it are dropped.

Caret.description: The caret, in codepoints from the start of Text, read clamped to Text's length; typing and the editing keys move it.

TextElement.description: A UI element below the input whose UiText shows the input's Text, with the caret while focused; null shows nothing.

Placeholder.description: A UI element below the input shown only while its Text is empty (a hint); null for none.

Animator.description: Poses a skeleton from layers of animation clips, blended by their weights, each fixed step; skinned meshes on the entity and below it follow.

Skeleton.description: The skeleton the layers' clips pose; null poses nothing.

Layers.description: The layers, at most eight, blended in order over the skeleton's rest pose.

Playing.description: Whether the layers' times advance each fixed step; the pose follows the times either way.

RootMotion.description: What happens to the skeleton's root motion: kept in the pose, applied to the entity or only reported.

SkinnedMesh.description: Deforms the entity's MeshRenderer mesh: its skin follows the nearest Animator on the entity or above it, and its morph targets take weights.

MorphWeights.description: One weight in [-1, 1] per morph target of the mesh, in order; a missing weight is the target's default, and an animated weight overrides it.

ParticleEmitter.description: Emits camera-facing textured particles from the entity: a presentation-only, seeded simulation that never changes the state hash and has no gameplay collision.

Playing.description: Whether the emitter emits; live particles finish their lives either way.

Loop.description: Whether emission repeats every Duration seconds; otherwise it stops after one cycle.

Duration.description: The length of one emission cycle, in seconds; Burst is emitted at each cycle's start.

Rate.description: Particles emitted per second while playing.

Burst.description: Particles emitted at once at the start of each cycle, at most MaxParticles.

MaxParticles.description: The most particles alive at once; beyond it no new particle is emitted until one dies.

Seed.description: Seeds the emitter's random stream together with the entity's id, so a replay shows the same particles in every build.

Lifetime.description: The range a new particle's lifetime is drawn from, in seconds: (minimum, maximum).

Speed.description: The range a new particle's speed is drawn from, in metres per second: (minimum, maximum).

Size.description: The range a new particle's size is drawn from, in metres: (minimum, maximum).

Shape.description: Where new particles start and which way they move.

ShapeRadius.description: The radius of the Sphere shape and of the Cone shape's base disc, in metres.

ConeAngle.description: The Cone shape's half angle from the local -Z axis, in degrees.

BoxHalfExtents.description: The Box shape's half extents, in metres.

Acceleration.description: The acceleration of every live particle, in metres per second squared, in the SimulationSpace (set (0, -9.81, 0) for gravity).

Drag.description: How quickly particles slow down, per second.

SimulationSpace.description: Whether live particles stay where they were emitted or move with the emitter.

Texture.description: The particle's texture; null uses the built-in soft disc (engine://Textures/Particle).

Blend.description: How particles are blended into the image.

ColorOverLife.description: At most eight colour keys over a particle's life, in ascending Time, interpolated linearly; empty keeps particles white and opaque.

SizeOverLife.description: At most eight size factors over a particle's life, in ascending Time, interpolated linearly; empty keeps the start size.

ParticleLook.description: How the entity's ParticleEmitter's particles look: a flipbook from a sprite sheet, rotation and spin, soft edges against the scene, alignment and HDR intensity. Presentation only, like the emitter.

SpriteSheet.description: The flipbook's sprite sheet, whose frames replace the emitter's Texture; null draws the emitter's Texture whole.

FirstFrame.description: The first frame of the flipbook's range, an index into the sheet's frames.

FrameCount.description: The number of frames in the flipbook's range; 0 takes every frame from FirstFrame to the sheet's last.

FrameMode.description: Whether the range plays over each particle's life or one frame is picked per particle.

FrameCycles.description: How many times OverLife plays the frame range over a particle's life.

BlendFrames.description: Whether OverLife cross-fades each frame into the next, so a short range plays smoothly.

StartRotation.description: The range a new particle's angle is drawn from, in degrees: (minimum, maximum); positive turns counter-clockwise as seen.

Spin.description: The range a new particle's spin is drawn from, in degrees per second: (minimum, maximum); positive turns counter-clockwise as seen.

Alignment.description: How each particle's quad is laid: facing the camera, along its velocity, or flat.

VelocityStretch.description: With Velocity alignment, the quad's length is its size plus its speed across the view times this, in seconds.

SoftDistance.description: The depth over which a particle fades out as it nears the surface behind it, in metres; 0 cuts it hard where it meets it.

Intensity.description: Multiplies the particles' colour (not their opacity), so above 1 they are brighter than white and bloom.

IrradianceVolume.description: A box of baked irradiance probes that lights the diffuse surfaces inside it with the light their surroundings bounce; lighting.bake bakes it.

Data.description: The baked volume that lighting.bake writes beside the scene and assigns; null (not baked) lights nothing.

Size.description: The box's size in metres, centred on the entity in its local axes.

ProbeCountX.description: The probes along the box's local X axis, the outer ones on its faces.

ProbeCountY.description: The probes along the box's local Y axis, the outer ones on its faces.

ProbeCountZ.description: The probes along the box's local Z axis, the outer ones on its faces.

Intensity.description: The unitless strength of the baked indirect light.

BlendDistance.description: The distance inside the box's faces over which its light fades to the Environment's, in metres.

ReflectionProbe.description: A baked reflection of the probe's surroundings that glossy surfaces inside its box reflect instead of the Environment; lighting.bake bakes it.

Data.description: The baked reflection, an Environment that lighting.bake writes beside the scene and assigns; null (not baked) reflects nothing.

Size.description: The box whose surfaces reflect the probe, in metres, centred on the entity in its local axes.

BoxProjection.description: Whether reflections are corrected for the box (parallax-corrected), so a room's reflection lines up with its walls.

Resolution.description: The bake's capture cube face, in texels: a power of two.

Intensity.description: The unitless strength of the reflection.

BlendDistance.description: The distance inside the box's faces over which its reflection fades to the Environment's, in metres.

Terrain.description: A heightfield laid out under the entity and drawn with up to four material layers blended by a splat map; sculpt and paint it with terrain.edit.

Heightfield.description: The heightfield whose samples shape the terrain; null draws nothing.

Size.description: The terrain's extent along its local X and Z axes from the entity's origin, in metres.

HeightScale.description: The height of the largest heightfield sample above the entity's origin, in metres.

Layers.description: At most four material layers, weighed by the splat map's red, green, blue and alpha channels; empty draws one white layer.

SplatMap.description: The texture whose channels weigh the layers per point (a data texture, imported with Usage Linear and Compression None); null draws the first layer alone.

ReceiveShadows.description: Whether shadows fall on the terrain.

LodBias.description: Scales the distances at which the terrain's chunks drop detail; above 1 keeps detail farther.

TerrainCollider.description: The entity's Terrain as a static height field in the physics world, colliding with exactly the surface that is drawn.

Layer.description: Physics layer name from project settings, of the terrain's own static body (unused when the terrain joins another body: a RigidBody on or above the entity, or a collider-only ancestor's).

Friction.description: The friction coefficient of the terrain's own static body (unused when the terrain joins another body, as Layer); a contact uses the geometric mean of both bodies' values.

Restitution.description: The bounciness of the terrain's own static body, from 0 to 1 (unused when the terrain joins another body, as Layer); a contact uses the larger of both bodies' values.

PrefabOverride.description: One recorded difference between an outermost prefab instance and its prefab.

Path.description: The entity the override applies to: its id in the outermost prefab, or the ids of the nested instance roots on the way and then its id in its own prefab.

Kind.description: What the override changes: a field, an added or removed component, an entity key, or the entity removed from the instance.

Component.description: The registry name of the component for Field, AddComponent and RemoveComponent; empty for EntityKey and RemoveEntity.

Field.description: The field name for Field; Name, Active or Tags for EntityKey; empty otherwise.

Value.description: The overriding value, checked against the schema of its target: the field, the whole component, or the entity key.

ScriptSlot.description: One behaviour of a Script component.

Fields.description: Overrides of the script's declared fields, by name.

ExecutionOrder.description: Callbacks run in (ExecutionOrder, canonical entity order, slot) order.

UiTheme.description: The state tints of a canvas's widgets: each multiplies the colour of a widget element's own UiImage in that state.

Normal.description: The tint of an interactable widget that is neither hovered, pressed nor focused.

Hovered.description: The tint of a widget under the pointer.

Pressed.description: The tint of a widget the pointer presses.

Focused.description: The tint of the widget that has keyboard and gamepad focus.

Disabled.description: The tint of a widget whose Interactable is false.

UiPadding.description: Insets of a UI layout container's rectangle, in canvas units.

Left.description: The inset from the left edge.

Top.description: The inset from the top edge.

Right.description: The inset from the right edge.

Bottom.description: The inset from the bottom edge.

AnimatorLayer.description: One layer of an Animator's blend stack: a clip played at a time, speed and weight.

Clip.description: The animation clip the layer plays; null plays nothing.

Time.description: How far into the clip the layer is, in seconds; advanced each fixed step by the step times Speed.

Speed.description: How fast the layer's time advances; 0 holds it.

Weight.description: How much the layer's animated joints override the layers before it, from 0 (none) to 1 (fully).

Loop.description: Whether the clip starts again at its end; otherwise its last pose holds.

ParticleColorKey.description: One key of a particle colour curve over the particle's life.

Time.description: The particle's age over its lifetime at this key, from 0 (born) to 1 (dying).

Color.description: The linear colour with opacity in the fourth component at this key.

ParticleSizeKey.description: One key of a particle size curve over the particle's life.

Time.description: The particle's age over its lifetime at this key, from 0 (born) to 1 (dying).

Size.description: The factor of the particle's start size at this key.

TerrainLayer.description: One material layer of a Terrain, tiled over its surface where its splat map channel weighs it.

BaseColorMap.description: The layer's colour texture; null is white, so the layer is its Tint.

NormalMap.description: The layer's tangent-space normal map; null is flat.

Tint.description: The linear colour that multiplies the layer's base colour.

Tiling.description: The metres one repeat of the layer's maps covers in the terrain's local XZ plane.

Entity.description: One entity: its entity keys, then its components.

ID.description: The entity's id: 16 hex digits, unique within the file.

Parent.description: The parent entity's id, or null for a root.

Active.description: Whether the entity itself is active.

Components.description: The entity's components keyed by registry name; unknown components are preserved on save (§6), so they are allowed.
